svg.aria-label: A grid of subscription tiers against countries showing the monthly list price as a share of monthly income. The same $20 tier runs from under 4% of monthly income in South Africa to over 20% in Ethiopia.
svg.text: What a monthly AI subscription costs, as a share of income
Published USD list price against GNI per capita, Atlas method, divided by 12. Whether a provider offers regional
pricing is recorded in the register, not assumed here.
Higher shares mean a greater portion of monthly income.
Data: the Observatory record · CC BY 4.0 · compiled 2026-10-01 · list prices; a regional price where one is published is shown in the register
